processes.name: Sitara deal ticket requests from Producer Services to the ticket-entry desk
processes.description: Producer Services (Vance Taylor, Susan Smith, Melissa Graves) emails Tom Acton the counterparty, meter, volume and price for each new well or spot deal. Tom keys it into Sitara and replies with the new ticket number. Corrections follow by reply when pricing is wrong.
processes.stall_points: Details are re-typed from email into Sitara and errors (wrong price) need a second email. Requesters wait for the ticket number reply and must ask for it explicitly.
processes.automation: A structured request form that writes the ticket draft and returns the ticket number automatically. Validate price and meter against the contract.

processes.name: Expired or missing deal extensions and accounting arrangements for flowing meters
processes.description: Schedulers and allocators find gas flowing at a meter with no valid Sitara deal (expired, wrong dates, wrong meter). They email Daren Farmer or Stacey Neuweiler to extend or create a deal, then ask Anita Luong or Fred Boas to set up an accounting arrangement and reallocate.
processes.stall_points: Every case waits on one person (Daren) to extend or create the deal. Requesters send reminders and the same meter reappears in later months.
processes.automation: Flag allocation exceptions where flow has no active deal. Propose a deal extension for one-click approval and auto-create the accounting arrangement.

processes.name: Monthly and intra-month nomination changes from customers and producers into Sitara/POPS
processes.description: Customers and producers (Enron Methanol, KCS Josey Ranch, Mobil, Equistar, EOG, Yates) send monthly nominations or revisions by email. Logistics staff re-enter volumes in Sitara or POPS and tell risk owners to fix risk assignment.
processes.stall_points: Each change is re-keyed by hand and downstream owners are notified by separate email. Entry mistakes such as 18,500 vs 18,000 are found later and need another email.
processes.automation: Parse nomination emails into a structured change list and apply it to the ticket. Notify risk owners automatically with the diff.

processes.name: Pipeline nomination spreadsheets forwarded to schedulers
processes.description: Ami Chokshi receives daily nomination, change and availability spreadsheets from Reliant, TXU and Devon and forwards them unchanged to the scheduling team. Schedulers then open the attachments and apply the changes.
processes.stall_points: Attachments with blank subjects are forwarded by hand each time. Recipients must open each spreadsheet to find the change.
processes.automation: Auto-ingest the attachment and post a summary of changed volumes per meter to the scheduling queue.

processes.name: Sitara vs MOPS/POPS volume discrepancy research
processes.description: Volume, allocation or nomination mismatches are found at month close (Torch/El Sordo split, Shoreline sale, gathering BAV, meter 9769). Questions are forwarded up to Daren Farmer. Daren researches both systems and the answer goes back through several forwards.
processes.stall_points: Questions sit unanswered and are chased several times. Problems are escalated to Daren rather than solved by logistics, and the resolution takes multi-hop forwarding.
processes.automation: Daily comparison of MOPS vs POPS nominated and confirmed volumes per path, with exceptions surfaced before close.

processes.name: Monthly cost-center, survey and allocation data collection from Energy Operations managers
processes.description: Finance and strategic operations staff email the management distribution each month asking for hours surveys, activity driver surveys, allocation percentages and RC report checks. Managers fill in spreadsheets by hand and return them by a deadline.
processes.stall_points: Each month the same spreadsheets are re-completed manually with tight Friday deadlines. Errors in RC charges are found only by managers reviewing reports.
processes.automation: Pre-populate the surveys from the previous month and prior allocations. Flag RC charges that differ from the Org Database headcount.

processes.name: Meeting and calendar coordination for logistics and management teams
processes.description: Assistants and managers schedule project, offsite and lunch meetings by email, rescheduling and re-asking for availability. They also collect calendars from each manager.
processes.stall_points: Meetings are cancelled and rescheduled, with availability polled by reply. Each invite is a separate manual email.
processes.automation: Shared calendar scheduling with availability polling and automatic reschedule notices.

processes.name: Monthly flow, storage and industrial report distribution
processes.description: Staff compile monthly or month-to-date reports and email them as attachments: HL&P flow volumes to Janet Wallis, storage withdrawals to Cilco, and the industrial buyback report that Robert Lloyd inherited from Ken Seaman.
processes.stall_points: Reports are rebuilt and emailed by hand, with a file requested from another person each time. Knowledge sits with individuals who are leaving.
processes.automation: Schedule the report from the source data and send to a fixed distribution list.
